sources.title: GitHub - Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
sources.snippet: Base model — works with any MiniMax-H3 base: full (bf16, int8_convrot) and the pruned/curve variants (pruned_int8, pruned_fp8). The node detects a pruned base automatically and re-injects the LoRA's time-conditioning at run time (a small silu (t_emb) grid ships with the node for this), so one LoRA file covers every base.
